    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        assert input.length() >= 1 && input.length() <= 8 : "Invalid input length";
        if (input.charAt(0) == '0') {
            System.out.println(input.length() > 1 ? "0" : "1");
            return;
        }
        int startVal = Integer.parseInt("1" + "0".repeat(input.length() - 1));
        if (startVal == 1) {
            startVal = 0;
        } else if (startVal == 10) {
            startVal = 25;
        }
        int endVal = Integer.parseInt("9".repeat(input.length()));
        int totalCount = 0;
        for (int number = startVal; number <= endVal; number += 25) {
            if (matchesPattern(number, input)) {
                totalCount++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalCount);
    }

    private static boolean matchesPattern(int number, String pattern) {
        String numStr = String.valueOf(number);
        char previousX = '*';
        for (int i = 0; i < pattern.length(); i++) {
            char ch = pattern.charAt(i);
            if (ch == '_') {
                continue;
            } else if (ch == 'X') {
                if (previousX != '*' && previousX != numStr.charAt(i)) {
                    return false;
                }
                previousX = numStr.charAt(i);
            } else if (ch != numStr.charAt(i)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
